judgment_calls: The monitor is POLL-driven (evaluatePostApplyGuardrailsAsync is meant to be called on a recurring sweep for every event still in 'monitoring'), not push-driven/event-subscribed — matching the org-optimizer's existing cron-sweep architecture (org_optimizer_run_service.ts) rather than introducing a new real-time hook/event-bus mechanism into this codebase. Wiring an actual recurring sweep caller is D2.5's scope (the issue's own text: 'starts watching' — D2.2 defines the watch/evaluate primitive; D2.5 'wires it all together').

The monitor evaluates ALL guardrails in the closed registry (GUARDRAIL_NAMES) unconditionally for every PostApplyEvent, unlike C3's experiment evidence-bundle mechanism which only evaluates a per-experiment DECLARED subset. This is a deliberate blanket safety net for every applied proposal (most proposal kinds have no evidence bundle/declared guardrails at all), not a narrowing of C3's existing declared-subset behavior for experiments (which is untouched).

`treatment-integrity-failure-rate` folds in enrollment rows from any causal-runtime-v2 experiment associated with the proposal (via AgentOrgExperimentsRepository.listByProposalAsync); a plain (non-experiment) applied proposal has an empty enrollment set, so that specific guardrail can structurally never fire for it — proven acceptable because `checkTreatmentIntegrityFailureRate` already returns `breached:false` below its `minSampleCount` floor for an empty array, not a new special case added here.

DEFAULT_MONITORING_WINDOW_MS (1 hour) and DEFAULT_MIN_GUARDRAIL_SAMPLE_COUNT (5) are fixed ponytail-commented constants, matching C3/C4's established closed-constant style for guardrail thresholds — not yet configurable per proposal kind.

The auto-repair trigger seam mirrors org_proposal_apply_service.ts's existing registerProposalApplier/registerProposalValidator + resetProposalPluginsForTests pattern (register/reset functions on a module-level mutable binding) rather than inventing a new plugin mechanism. A per-call `deps.triggerAutoRepair` override additionally exists for injecting a spy without mutating global registration state across parallel tests.

Added AgentRunOutcomesRepository.listByProfileSinceAsync (a new profile-scoped, proposal-agnostic read) plus a supporting idx_agent_run_outcomes_profile index on both engines — the existing listByExperimentAsync/listReceiptBackedByExperimentAsync methods are experiment-scoped only and cannot serve this monitor's 'any run on this profile' read.
